changelog:
alibabacloud-oss-manage-network-probe v0.0.2

- Added requirement: all CLI invocations must include `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-oss-manage-network-probe` for monitoring and audit.
- Installation workflow updated to set user-agent header using `aliyun configure ai-mode set-user-agent`.
- Enforced `aliyun plugin update` after environment and profile validation.
- Documentation improvements on CLI environment preparation and explicit user-agent usage.
- No functional logic or workflow changes to probing steps.
